topics.title: Radio Guests Engage in Absurd Roleplay
topics.summary: During a live broadcast, Howard and his co-hosts engage in increasingly bizarre conversations with guests including Marilyn Monroe (played by an actor) and JFK, involving fabricated scenarios like filming Ben Hur as rock music. The conversation quickly devolves into absurd roleplay and tangents about personal experiences culminating in simulated drug use.

topics.title: Erratic Caller Details Disturbing Fantasies
topics.summary: A radio show segment features an increasingly erratic caller detailing bizarre fantasies involving sleeping with prominent figures like Martin Luther King Jr. and sharing snuff films while taking photographs, culminating in a request for a ‘chubby’ and references to disturbing imagery including sheep, Marilyn Monroe, and various animals.

topics.title: Stern Demands Spanking and Calls Regis
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, Howard Stern repeatedly threatens to spank callers who disrespect him, demanding they go on Regis and Kathie Lee to publicly apologize or face the consequences. He escalates his demands with vulgar language, references Marilyn Chambers’ 1-800 number, and engages in bizarre conversations including discussing California Dreaming while attempting to get a caller to reveal details about their personal life.

topics.title: Chocolate Pudding & Unconventional Confessions
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, callers engage in bizarre conversations including discussing chocolate pudding with a spanking and attempting to contact Jack Martling for a Jaguar. A brief but awkward exchange occurs involving romantic confessions, personal struggles, and an attempt to impress a female listener by describing musical preferences.

topics.title: Stern’s Phone Call Mishap
topics.summary: Howard Stern attempts to contact Sammy Davis Jr., resulting in a prolonged and bizarre phone call filled with inappropriate questions about sexuality, celebrity appearances, and an impromptu game of Jeopardy. Technical difficulties and the girls' persistent questioning create chaotic interruptions as they discuss modeling opportunities and potential scandals.

topics.title: Jeopardy! Rule Disputes and Clothing
topics.summary: During a Jeopardy! game, contestants repeatedly struggle with the rules regarding removing clothing items like shoes and belts, leading to arguments and frustration over correct answers and inappropriate prompts. Attempts at sexualized questions are rejected resulting in premature termination of play.
